scope: Raw DROID SVO/HDF5 to SequenceExample alignment v2
summary: After helper staging, the strict GPU gate rejected GPU 5 because another workload had reduced free memory to 11,116 MiB.
evidence: The audit required 81,000 MiB free and selected no co-scheduled fallback.
The subsequent inventory showed compute processes on all eight a800-1 GPUs.
lessons: A previously free GPU can be claimed between experiment planning and launch; strict revalidation must remain fail-closed.
limitations: No SVO frame was decoded and no alignment conclusion was produced.
next_actions: Queue the audit until a GPU has less than 1 GiB allocated and no compute process.
